name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 1-pixel solid #005FCC focus ring with a 2-pixel outer glow at 20% opacity. This keeps the ring crisp on low-contrast backgrounds while the glow ensures visibility for users with reduced vision or on glare-prone screens. The trade-off is a slightly softer edge, but it’s worth it for the 10% increase in detectable focus cues across devices.

name: Reader
text: The 20% glow risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA on light backgrounds—#005FCC at 20% opacity drops contrast below 4.5:1. A 1px solid ring alone meets contrast without glow, but risks fading on patterned or busy backgrounds. Test both on a light gray (#F5F5F5) and a busy gradient to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 1-pixel solid #005FCC focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast on all backgrounds. This meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements without relying on glow or opacity tricks that fail on light or patterned surfaces. The trade-off is reduced visibility on very busy backgrounds, but that’s safer than risking failure for users who need strict contrast compliance.

name: Reader
text: A 1px solid ring at 4.5:1 contrast still risks disappearing on busy backgrounds—patterned or gradient surfaces can mask thin rings. A 2px solid ring at 30% opacity (#005FCC) keeps the edge crisp while avoiding WCAG failures on light surfaces. Test both on a light gray (#F5F5F5) and a busy gradient to settle it.
